# EasyPost Developer Docs

> EasyPost is a shipping API for buying postage, comparing carrier rates, tracking
> packages, verifying addresses, insuring shipments, and automating logistics across
> 100+ carriers including USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL.

## Machine-readable documentation

Almost every documentation page on this site has a plain-Markdown twin. Prefer it over
the HTML page: it carries the same prose and the same code samples in all 8 supported
languages, and is a median of 18x smaller. The Carrier Guides, Libraries and Releases
index pages have no twin; use their HTML pages.

- Markdown for any page: prefix the path with `/markdown` and append `.md`
  `https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pagination` -> `https://docs.easypost.com/markdown/docs/pagination.md`
- Full page index (JSON): https://docs.easypost.com/doc-index.json
  One entry per page with `url`, `markdownUrl`, `category`, `keywords`, `audience`,
  and a `notes` field describing when that page is the right one to read.
- Sitemap: https://docs.easypost.com/sitemap.xml

The complete index of pages, grouped by category, is appended at the end of this file.

## API basics

- Base URL: `https://api.easypost.com/v2`
- Auth: HTTP Basic, API key as the username with an empty password
  `curl -u "$EASYPOST_API_KEY": https://api.easypost.com/v2/shipments`
- Test mode: use a test API key; no postage is purchased and no carrier is contacted.
- Responses are paginated in descending order via `before_id` / `after_id`, with
  `page_size` up to 100. See the Pagination page.
- Official client libraries: C#, Go, Java, Node, PHP, Python, Ruby.
  https://docs.easypost.com/libraries
